verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims 'automatic syncing across 1,000s of native integrations' and support 'from card swipe to month-end close', including automated GL coding and one-click accruals, which points to built-in accounting sync that reduces manual entries. Nothing names a specific ERP or documents that the sync is real-time or bidirectional; the Accounting API and webhooks are developer building blocks, not the sync itself. Missing for 10: named ERP connectors (e.g., NetSuite/QuickBooks), documented bidirectional data flow, real-time sync guarantees, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries

citations.quote: Simplify every task that finance touches with automatic syncing across 1,000s of native integrations.
